title: Amelia | Polka dot two-piece with effortless elegance
bodyHtml:
Amelia is your go-to for days by the water and warm sunshine. This coordinated set pairs a neat crop top with high-waisted capris for a flattering, elongated line, while the charming polka dot pattern adds a refined, relaxed touch. Wear it for a seaside stroll, sunset drinks, or a long lunch in coastal towns—it's the kind of piece that turns heads without trying. Effortlessly chic and surprisingly hard to find.

Why you'll love it

  • Two-piece coordination that works as a complete look or mixed with other pieces
  • High waist that naturally flatters and skims beautifully without clinging
  • Sweet polka dot print with understated, timeless appeal
  • All-day comfort—perfect for beach, city or holiday getaways
  • Flowing silhouette that moves with you, never rigid or restricting
  • Rare to find a matching set this well-designed and versatile
  • Style with simple slides and minimal jewellery to let the set shine

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
